feature-modularization.code:
from collections import defaultdict

OWNERS = {"work_orders": "workorder-module", "assets": "asset-module", "sync_cursor": "sync-module"}
WRITES = [
    ("workorder-module", "work_orders", "wo-118", "status=complete dirty=1"),
    ("sync-module", "work_orders", "wo-118", "status=open dirty=0 (server copy)"),
    ("asset-module", "assets", "a-77", "valve=flagged"),
    ("sync-module", "sync_cursor", "global", "cursor=5891"),
    ("photos-module", "work_orders", "wo-121", "photo_count=3"),
]

violations = 0
writers = defaultdict(set)
for module, table, record, change in WRITES:
    writers[(table, record)].add(module)
    owner = OWNERS[table]
    if module == owner:
        print(f"ok: {module} -> {table}/{record}")
    else:
        violations += 1
        print(f"VIOLATION {violations}: {module} wrote {table}/{record} ({change}) — owner is {owner}")

doubles = sorted(k for k, v in writers.items() if len(v) > 1)
for table, record in doubles:
    print(f"double-writer: {table}/{record} written by {len(writers[(table, record)])} modules — silent overwrite risk")

print(f"audit: {violations} ownership violations, {len(doubles)} double-writer records across {len(WRITES)} writes")

platform-lifecycle-constraints.code:
STAGES = ["ui-state", "local-db-commit", "sync-queued", "server-ack"]
SCENARIOS = [
    ("tap-then-immediate-kill", "ui-state"),
    ("onpause-commit-then-kill", "local-db-commit"),
    ("queued-then-network-drop", "sync-queued"),
    ("full-roundtrip", "server-ack"),
]


def survives_kill(reached):
    return STAGES.index(reached) >= STAGES.index("local-db-commit")


def visible_to_dispatcher(reached):
    return reached == "server-ack"


surviving = 0
for name, reached in SCENARIOS:
    ok = survives_kill(reached)
    if ok:
        surviving += 1
    device = "SURVIVES" if ok else "LOST"
    server = "sees it" if visible_to_dispatcher(reached) else "does not see it yet"
    print(f"{name}: reached {reached} -> device {device}, dispatcher {server}")

print(f"{surviving}/{len(SCENARIOS)} scenarios survive an OS kill — only work at or past {STAGES[1]} is real")
print(f"the UI checkmark is drawn at {STAGES[0]}; the promise is kept at {STAGES[3]}")

    ("wo-201", "status=completed", 836, 7, "status=reassigned", 845, 8),
    ("wo-204", "notes=valve worn", 851, 4, "(unchanged)", 810, 4),
    ("wo-207", "photos=3", 829, 2, "(unchanged)", 838, 2),
]

print("policy A — wall-clock last-writer-wins:")
losses_a = 0
for rec, local_val, local_ts, base, server_val, server_ts, server_ver in ROWS:
    if local_ts > server_ts:
        print(f"  {rec}: local {local_val} kept (ts {local_ts} > {server_ts})")
    else:
        losses_a += 1
        print(f"  {rec}: local {local_val} DISCARDED (ts {local_ts} <= {server_ts}) — silent loss")

print("policy B — version token + dirty flag:")
losses_b = 0
queued = 0
for rec, local_val, local_ts, base, server_val, server_ts, server_ver in ROWS:
    if base == server_ver:
        print(f"  {rec}: push accepted at base v{base} -> v{base + 1}")
    else:
        queued += 1
        print(f"  {rec}: CONFLICT base v{base} vs server v{server_ver} — queued, both edits preserved")

print(f"verdict: policy A silently lost {losses_a} of {len(ROWS)} rows; policy B lost {losses_b}, queued {queued}")
print("wo-207 is the tell: nobody else edited it — a lagging device clock alone destroyed the write under policy A")

repository-sync-contract.code:
SERVER = {"wo-310": ("reassigned", 5), "wo-311": ("open", 2), "wo-312": ("open", 9)}
QUEUE = [
    ("wo-310", "completed", 4),
    ("wo-311", "completed", 2),
    ("wo-312", "notes-appended", 9),
    ("wo-311", "signed-off", 3),
]

accepted = 0
conflicts = []
for rec, value, base in QUEUE:
    cur_val, cur_ver = SERVER[rec]
    if base == cur_ver:
        SERVER[rec] = (value, cur_ver + 1)
        accepted += 1
        print(f"push {rec} base=v{base}: ACCEPTED -> v{cur_ver + 1} ({value})")
    else:
        conflicts.append(rec)
        print(f"push {rec} base=v{base}: CONFLICT server at v{cur_ver} ({cur_val}) — queued, nothing overwritten")

print(f"result: {accepted} accepted, {len(conflicts)} conflict(s) queued: {', '.join(conflicts)}")
for rec in sorted(SERVER):
    val, ver = SERVER[rec]
    print(f"server {rec}: v{ver} {val}")

flaky-network-repair.code:
SCRIPT = ["drop", "drop", "drop", "deliver-response-lost", "deliver"]
KEY = "wo-118:complete:a91f"

server_store = {}
next_id = [401]


def server_apply(key):
    if key in server_store:
        return server_store[key], "replayed"
    oid = next_id[0]
    next_id[0] += 1
    server_store[key] = oid
    return oid, "applied"


delay = 2
total_wait = 0
for n, fate in enumerate(SCRIPT, 1):
    if fate == "drop":
        print(f"attempt {n}: dropped in transit — retry in {delay}s")
        total_wait += delay
        delay = min(delay * 2, 30)
        continue
    oid, how = server_apply(KEY)
    if fate == "deliver-response-lost":
        print(f"attempt {n}: server {how} order {oid} but response lost — retry in {delay}s")
        total_wait += delay
        delay = min(delay * 2, 30)
        continue
    print(f"attempt {n}: server {how} order {oid} — client confirmed")
    break

print(f"orders created: {len(server_store)} · total backoff waited: {total_wait}s · duplicates: {len(server_store) - 1}")

session-expiry.code:
EVENTS = [
    (0, "login"), (5, "go-offline"), (12, "edit"), (30, "token-expires"),
    (33, "edit"), (42, "go-online"), (42, "silent-refresh"), (43, "sync"),
]

token_valid = False
online = True
sync_frozen = False
draft_version = 0
dirty = False
drafts_destroyed_by_auth = 0

for minute, kind in EVENTS:
    if kind == "login":
        token_valid = True
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] login: access + refresh issued")
    elif kind == "go-offline":
        online = False
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] offline — basement")
    elif kind == "edit":
        draft_version += 1
        dirty = True
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] edit committed -> durable draft v{draft_version} dirty=1")
    elif kind == "token-expires":
        token_valid = False
        sync_frozen = True
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] access token EXPIRED -> sync frozen; draft v{draft_version} untouched")
    elif kind == "go-online":
        online = True
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] network back")
    elif kind == "silent-refresh":
        token_valid = True
        print(f"[{minute:>2}m] silent refresh: new access token, no login wall")
    elif kind == "sync":
        if token_valid and online:
            sync_frozen = False
            print(f"[{minute:>2}m] sync thawed: draft v{draft_version} pushed with base-version, dirty=0")
            dirty = False

print(f"invariant: {drafts_destroyed_by_auth} drafts destroyed by auth events; final draft v{draft_version} synced={not dirty}")
print("the expiry moved WHEN sync ran — it never touched WHAT was written")

small-screen-workflow.code:
LAYOUTS = {
    "menu-buried": [
        ("open overflow menu", 1, "stretch", 0),
        ("tap job actions", 1, "easy", 0),
        ("tap mark complete", 1, "easy", 0),
        ("type completion note", 1, "easy", 1),
        ("scroll to save", 2, "easy", 0),
        ("tap save top-right", 1, "stretch", 0),
    ],
    "bottom-sheet": [
        ("tap complete in bottom bar", 1, "easy", 0),
        ("pick note template chip", 1, "easy", 0),
        ("append one detail", 1, "easy", 1),
        ("tap confirm in thumb zone", 1, "easy", 0),
    ],
}

totals = {}
for name, steps in LAYOUTS.items():
    cost = 0.0
    stretches = 0
    for label, taps, reach, kb in steps:
        step_cost = taps + (0.5 * taps if reach == "stretch" else 0) + kb * 2
        if reach == "stretch":
            stretches += taps
        cost += step_cost
    totals[name] = cost
    print(f"{name}: {len(steps)} steps, one-hand cost {cost}, stretch taps {stretches}")

winner = min(totals, key=lambda k: totals[k])
loser = max(totals, key=lambda k: totals[k])
savings = round((totals[loser] - totals[winner]) / totals[loser] * 100)
print(f"winner: {winner} at {totals[winner]} vs {totals[loser]} — {savings}% cheaper per completion")
print(f"and the winner has zero stretch taps — the mis-tap class is gone, not just discounted")

loading-empty-error-states.code:
LEGAL = {
    ("idle", "fetch_start"): "loading",
    ("loading", "fetch_ok_data"): "loaded",
    ("loading", "fetch_ok_empty"): "empty",
    ("loading", "fetch_fail"): "error",
    ("error", "retry"): "loading",
    ("empty", "fetch_start"): "loading",
    ("loaded", "fetch_start"): "refreshing",
    ("refreshing", "fetch_ok_data"): "loaded",
    ("refreshing", "fetch_ok_empty"): "empty",
    ("refreshing", "fetch_fail"): "loaded+banner",
    ("loaded+banner", "retry"): "refreshing",
    ("loaded+banner", "fetch_start"): "refreshing",
}

TRACE = [
    "fetch_start", "fetch_fail", "retry", "fetch_ok_data",
    "fetch_start", "fetch_fail",
    "retry", "fetch_ok_empty",
    "fetch_ok_data",
]

state = "idle"
legal = illegal = 0
for event in TRACE:
    nxt = LEGAL.get((state, event))
    if nxt is None:
        illegal += 1
        print(f"ILLEGAL: {event} in state {state} — unlisted transition, blank-screen bug class")
    else:
        legal += 1
        print(f"{state} --{event}--> {nxt}")
        state = nxt

print(f"trace done: {legal} legal transitions, {illegal} illegal caught, final state {state}")
print("the elevator event (fetch_fail over live data) landed in loaded+banner — stale kept, honesty shown, blank unrepresentable")

mobile-test-plan.code:
STATES = [("offline", 5), ("background-kill", 4), ("permission-revoked", 3), ("low-network", 4), ("cold-launch", 2)]
FLOWS = [("save-inspection", 5), ("sync-on-reconnect", 5), ("photo-upload", 4), ("login-refresh", 3), ("browse-list", 1)]
HOOKS = {
    "offline": "adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable",
    "background-kill": "adb shell am kill <pkg> mid-flow",
    "permission-revoked": "adb shell pm revoke <pkg> android.permission.CAMERA",
    "low-network": "Network Link Conditioner (3G profile)",
    "cold-launch": "adb shell am force-stop <pkg> && relaunch",
}

cells = []
for sname, sl in STATES:
    for fname, fi in FLOWS:
        cells.append((sl * fi, sname, fname))
cells.sort(key=lambda c: (-c[0], c[1], c[2]))

for risk, sname, fname in cells[:6]:
    print(f"risk {risk}: {fname} x {sname} — hook: {HOOKS[sname]}")

total = sum(c[0] for c in cells)
top6 = sum(c[0] for c in cells[:6])
happy = sum(fi * 2 for _, fi in FLOWS)  # every flow once, in cold-launch (likelihood 2)
print(f"top-6 cells carry {top6} of {total} total risk points ({round(top6 / total * 100)}%)")
print(f"the happy-path suite covers {happy} risk points ({round(happy / total * 100)}%) — green, and blind to the mission's bug at risk 25")

crash-and-analytics-signals.code:
lines = [f"session start u{n}" for n in range(1, 41)]
lines.append("crash u7 NullPointerException")
lines.append("sync_conflict wo-114 winner=server loser=local dirty=true")
lines.append("sync_conflict wo-131 winner=server loser=local dirty=true")
lines.append("sync_conflict wo-090 winner=local loser=server dirty=true")

sessions = sum(1 for l in lines if l.startswith("session start"))
crashes = sum(1 for l in lines if l.startswith("crash"))
rate = (sessions - crashes) / sessions * 100

conflicts = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("sync_conflict")]
silent = 0
policy_ok = 0
for c in conflicts:
    fields = dict(part.split("=") for part in c.split()[2:])
    if fields["winner"] == "server" and fields["loser"] == "local" and fields["dirty"] == "true":
        silent += 1
        record = c.split()[1]
        print(f"DATA LOSS: {record} — dirty local work lost to server copy")
    elif fields["winner"] == "local":
        policy_ok += 1

print(f"dashboard A: crash-free {rate:.1f}% ({sessions - crashes}/{sessions} sessions) — GREEN, ship faster")
print(f"dashboard B: crash-free {rate:.1f}% AND {silent} silent overwrites, {policy_ok} conflict(s) correctly kept local")
print(f"verdict: same log, same day — dashboard A is true and blind; {silent} technicians lost work while it was green")

STORE_ITEMS = [
    ("metadata + screenshots current", True),
    ("privacy labels accurate", True),
    ("no crash during review session", True),
    ("permissions policy compliant", True),
]
READINESS_ITEMS = [
    ("crash-free >= 99.5% on beta cohort", 3, True, True),
    ("offline write walkthrough recorded", 3, True, False),
    ("sync conflict table attached", 3, True, False),
    ("conflict analytics event verified in release build", 2, True, False),
    ("rollback / kill-switch plan", 2, False, True),
    ("store metadata current", 1, False, True),
]

store_pass = all(present for _, present in STORE_ITEMS)
print(f"gate 1 — store review: {'APPROVED' if store_pass else 'REJECTED'} ({sum(1 for _, p in STORE_ITEMS if p)}/{len(STORE_ITEMS)} policy items)")

total_w = sum(w for _, w, _, _ in READINESS_ITEMS)
have_w = sum(w for _, w, _, present in READINESS_ITEMS if present)
missing_blockers = [name for name, w, blocker, present in READINESS_ITEMS if blocker and not present]
score = round(have_w / total_w * 100)
for name in missing_blockers:
    print(f"missing blocker: {name}")
ready = not missing_blockers
print(f"gate 2 — field readiness: {'READY' if ready else 'NOT READY'} — evidence score {score}%, {len(missing_blockers)} blocker(s) missing")
print(f"the gap: this build is {'APPROVED' if store_pass else 'REJECTED'} and {'READY' if ready else 'NOT READY'} — the store asked 'may it exist?', nobody asked 'will it survive a basement?'")
